data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that expands or collapses content with optional header and icon.
data.what_it_does: Provides a reusable expandable panel and low‑level expandable widgets that can be customized via themes. It supports automatic scrolling, custom icons, and theming for animation and appearance.
use_when: You need a collapsible section in a list or card
You want consistent expand/collapse behavior across the app
You need automatic scrolling into view when expanding
avoid_when: You need complex state management beyond simple expand/collapse
You are building a highly custom animation that requires low‑level control
strengths: Easy to use with minimal boilerplate
weaknesses: Limited to expand/collapse; not a full state‑management solution
No built‑in support for nested or multi‑level expandables
Requires manual integration for custom animations
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import package; no special permissions or build_runner needed
